title: Know Your Boundaries: The Necessity of Explicit Behavioral Cloning in Offline RL

models_tested: Not applicable. The paper evaluates specific reinforcement learning algorithms (ARQ, TD3+BC, DT, CQL, IQL, BC, BCQ), not general-purpose Large Language Models.
